root_cause: The existing daily content-growth materializer passes all data/content-growth-events.json records into aggregateContentPerformance. The current evidence file holds a dated public-policy problem radar item with no content_id. The aggregator strictly requires content_id, so the daily run cannot materialize learning on that input. Also an RVO application deadline 2026-10-16 is earlier than today's date despite static CURRENT field.
fix: Add a provenance partition inside existing scheduled learning workflow; only attributable metric events enter ranking and revenue, traceable external research is preserved separately with expiry marker. Unknown or falsely unattributed metrics fail closed rather than silently ignored.
prevention_rule: Market radar evidence is not a GA4 event. Reject untraceable external signals, duplicate IDs and unattributed performance metrics; never present the absence of observed revenue events as verified zero revenue. Reuse existing cadence, policy and canonical Brain.
terminal_rule: Daily workflow Required/CodeQL protected delivery and its real scheduled run producing artifact with transparent attribution integrity; later production provider metrics must be independently read back.
